_comment: runner.lock — v0.10 single-instance guard for auto-runner.js. WRITTEN BY: auto-runner.js on startup (replaces .gamemaker-kit/.loop.lock model, which only gmk-loop owned). READ BY: /gmk-auto-start preflight check (c) and /gmk-auto-status. STALE RULE: heartbeat_at older than 5 minutes → preflight may auto-clear with a logged note. Active rule: if pid is alive on this host AND heartbeat_at is fresh, /gmk-auto-start refuses. The lock is intentionally a separate file from auto-state.json because crash-recovery has to differentiate 'state exists but runner died' from 'runner is live'.
